title: 一樣、太、夠 —— 還有你比較喜歡哪個

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Is the blue one as good as the red one?

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Almost, but it's not as cheap.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: And it's a bit too big for me.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Is the red one big enough?

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: A is as tall as B.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: A is not as big as B.
